events.name: HackDUCS
description_paragraphs: Embark on a coding odyssey at HackDUCS – Delhi University's epic hackathon where ideas evolve, friendships form, and innovation takes centre stage! Department of Computer Science, University of Delhi is organizing HackDUCS, a hybrid inter-university hackathon as part of its 20th Annual TechFest - Sankalan 2024!
Hackathon Tracks - Refer to hack.ducs.in for more details
Event Schedule - all times in IST

DAY 0 - 18/04/2024
  • 11:00 AM - Registrations Closed

DAY 1 - 19/04/2024
  • 12:00 PM - Presentation Submissions Due
  • 12:30 PM - Presentation Order Communicated
  • 01:00 PM - Preliminary Presentations Begin on GMeet/Zoom
  • 05:00 PM - Preliminary Presentations End
  • 07:00 PM - Results of Preliminary Round Declared
  • 08:00 PM - Instructions Communicated to Semi Finalist Teams

DAY 2 (Sankalan Day 1) - 20/04/2024
  • 09:00 AM - Offline Reporting (as feasible) and Disbursement of Event Kits
  • 10:00 AM - Inauguration and Workshop / Keynote - Hacking Begins

DAY 3 (Sankalan Day 2) - 21/04/2024
  • 09:00 AM - Offline Reporting
  • 10:00 AM - Project Demonstrations Begin (Hybrid)
  • 11:30 AM - Project Demonstrations End
  • 12:00 PM - Results of Demonstrations Declared and Communicated to Finalist Teams
  • 03:00 PM - Final Presentations Begin (Hybrid)
  • 05:00 PM - Final Presentations End
  • 05:30 PM - Results of Final Presentations / Winners Declared
  • 06:00 PM - Prize Disbursement Formalities


Pool Prize: INR 18,00,000+
rules:
• Eligibility: College/University Students; Team Size: 2-4; Cross-college teams allowed
  • Tracks will be released on Day 0 at 12:00 PM.
  • Development must start after release of tracks.
  • Projects submitted to other hackathons will not be considered.
  • Plagiarism will lead to disqualification.
  • All participants who participate in the event will receive event kits and swags from sponsors.
  • Preliminary Presentations:
  • Online presentations on Google Meet / Zoom.
  • Time Limit: 12-15 mins (8 mins + questions)
  • Slides: Maximum of 12 slides; Formats: .pptx, .pdf
  • Maximum of 5 teams from each track will be selected for demos
  • Project Demonstrations:
  • In-person project demonstration at event venue. Time Limit: 12-15 mins
  • Project must be submitted on Devfolio before the presentation begins.
  • Project source code must be hosted on a public repository on GitHub.
  • Short video demo needs to be uploaded on YouTube and submitted on Devfolio.
  • 10 teams qualify for Final Presentations
  • Final Presentations: This round will be conducted for selected teams after the project demonstration round to allow them to work upon feedback received from the judges and enable them to put their best foot forward. Winners will be decided based on the performance in this round.
  • No Time Limit 🙂
  • In-person presentation at event venue.
  • Qualified teams must arrange for travel and accommodation.
  • Food and beverages will be provided as part of the parent event.

events.name: Algoholics
description_paragraphs: Algoholics is a journey into the heart of algorithmic mastery, inspired by the words of Kristian Vistrup Madsen: "Programming is not about typing, it's about thinking, and algorithms are the way we express that thinking." We celebrate the art of problem-solving through coding puzzles, challenging you to unravel complexities with the utmost efficiency in space and time.

ONLINE PRELIMS (Sankalan Day 1)
  • 10:30 AM - Reporting
  • 11:00 AM - Event begins
  • 12:00 PM - Event Ends

OFFLINE MAINS (Sankalan Day 2)
  • 10:30 AM - Offline Reporting
  • 11:00 AM - Event Begins
  • 12:00 PM - Event Ends


Pool Prize: INR 6,000
rules:
• Eligibility: College/University Students
  • Team Size: Individual for round 1, Group of 2 for round 2; Cross-college teams are allowed.
  • Preliminary Round (Hybrid): This is an eliminating round. This round consist of 3 problems two of easy level and one of medium level in round one.
  • Participants will be given a set of three problems to solve.
  • Time limit: 60 minutes.
  • Top 20 Participants whose code gets executed successfully and has an optimal solution will be given highest preference.
  • Time taken to solve the problems will also be taken into consideration to qualify.
  • Decisions made by the event organizers will be final and binding.
  • Mains Round: (Offline)
  • It is required to report at the Department.
  • Selected participants with the group of one or two persons will be given a set of two problems to solve.
    • This round consists of one of medium level and another of hard level
  • Top Participants whose code gets executed successfully and has an optimal solution will be given highest preference.
  • Participants are required to share their account details through a form for transfer of prize money to winners.
  • Time taken to solve the problems will also be taken into consideration to qualify.
  • Decisions made by the event organizers will be final and binding.

events.name: Blind Coding
description_paragraphs: "Dive into the heart of coding adventure with  The Blind Coding Challenge"! Brace yourself for an exhilarating journey where your coding skills will be put to the ultimate test. In this thrilling competition, you'll embark on a quest to unravel the mystery of code, all while blindfolded from your screen and disconnected from the internet. Can you navigate through the darkness of uncertainty and emerge as the ultimate coding champion?

Venture into uncharted territory where screens remain dark, and ingenuity lights the way. No internet, no chatter – just you, your code, and the thrill of the challenge. Blind Coding offers a thrilling opportunity to push your limits and experience the adrenaline rush of coding like never before.

Pool Prize: INR 4,500
rules:
• Assemble your dream team of two adventurers (Only Two Members Are Allowed).
  • You'll have 60 minutes to conquer two coding problems - one of easy difficulty, and the other of medium complexity.
  • A total of 40 marks are up for grabs, with 15 marks dedicated to the easy problem and 25 marks for the medium one.
  • Exercise caution! Teams can briefly activate their screens twice for 30 seconds each, but beware, as a penalty of 5 points will be incurred per activation, closely monitored by our organizers.
  • Food and beverages will be provided as part of the parent event.
  • Success and efficiency are key! Priority will be given to code that executes flawlessly with the most optimal solution.
  • In the event of errors, elegance prevails! The second preference will go to code with the fewest errors.
  • In the case of a tiebreaker, timing is everything. The submission time will serve as the final determinant.
  • Decisions made by the event organizers will be final and binding.

events.name: Code Auction
description_paragraphs:
Codes are up for auction, but being the highest bidder is not enough to win the game! Call for coding enthusiasts who want to experience a thrilling journey of problem-solving, strategising, and collaboration. Some team members will participate in an auction, bidding for the challenges you wish. And the rest of the team will try to crack the code within a set time limit. Do you know your friends well enough to bid on the challenge suited for them? Join us at Code Auction to know!

Pool Prize: INR 6,000
rules:
• Eligibility: College/University Students; Team Size: 2-4; Cross-college teams allowed.
  • Time duration - 2 hr
  • 1 or 2 members (depending on number of participants in team) will participate in bidding
  • Other members will not participate in the “Auction” round
  • Each team will initially be given a fixed amount to bid on questions
  • Every team must purchase at least 3 questions to be eligible for “coding” round
  • There are 3 types of questions: easy, medium, hard, with prices being high to low respectively.
  • 10 - 15 participant teams will go in coding round
  • Once auction round ends, coding round begins with the other 1 or 2 members solving the challenges purchased by their teammates
  • The members who participated in Auction round will not participate in coding round

events.name: Squash the Bugs
description_paragraphs:
Squash some bugs and showcase your coding prowess! Dive into our code snippets, identify the bugs lurking within, and apply your programming wizardry to squash them into oblivion. Every bug fix brings you one step closer to the top of the scoreboard and ultimate glory. Prizes await the top bug squashers, but the real reward lies in the satisfaction of overcoming challenges and mastering the art of debugging.

Pool Prize: INR 4,500
rules:
• Eligibility: College/University Students; Individual Participant Only
  • Main Event: Time duration - 1 hr for each slot (if huge participation)
  • Code snippets will be provided and participants will have to find the errors/bugs and fix them.
  • Most probably on system, any online platform, but may change.

events.name: Jhankar
description_paragraphs: To dance is to be out of yourself.Larger, more beautiful, more powerful ~ Agnes De Mille

Welcome to the electrifying world of dance where rhythm meets innovation! Prepare to showcase your team's extraordinary talent in our upcoming group dance competition - JHANKAR , an event like no other. Immense yourself in the rich performing art called dance, as you witness the grace and fluidity of these stunning performances.

Participate now and win a chance to be secure your place amidst elegance.

Pool Prize: INR 15,000
rules:
• Eligibility : College/University Students; Team Size: 5-12.
  • Time Limit : 5-7 minutes
  • Slots allocated on first-come-first-basis
  • Performance music must be submitted at least 2 days before the event to facilitate smooth performance.
  • Props are allowed and have to be carried by participants.
  • Evaluation criteria: costumes,choreography,synchronization,creativity,overall stage performance.
  • Participants should carry their college id card with them.
  • Participants are required to share their account details through a form for transfer of prize money to winners.

events.name: Dastur-e-Mehfil
description_paragraphs:
Unleash your inner Wordsmith at Dastur-e-Mehfil,the Multilingual Literary Celebration where creativity takes center stage. Explore the realm of writing,expression and debates. Showcase your skills in open poetry competition inviting college students, including those from inter-colleges, to showcase their poetic talent. Join the battle of wits and express your creativity.Celebrate the battle of language,imagination, and express at Dastur-e-Mehfil.

Please register on website before filling this form

Form Link ↗

Pool Prize: INR 4000
rules:
• This is a poetry competition where college students can participate.
  • The theme will be open, and there will be two rounds.
  • In the preliminary round, the participants will submit their pieces on a Google Form, and the top pieces will be selected for the final round.
  • The selected participants will have to perform them live in the department, and the positions will be given according to the score provided by the judges.
  • The time limit is 3 to 5 minutes.
  • The pieces must be self-written; plagiarized pieces will be disqualified.
  • The pieces must not be offending in any way to any religion, caste, gender, etc. If they do, they will be disqualified

events.name: Chakravyuh
description_paragraphs: Calling all adventurous spirits and puzzle enthusiasts! Get ready to embark on an exhilarating journey of discovery at the Treasure Hunt during the most awaited fest, Sankalan.

Gather your friends, form teams, and prepare for an exciting afternoon of clues, challenges, and hidden treasures scattered throughout our vibrant department. Whether you're a seasoned explorer or a first-time participant, this event promises thrills and excitement for all.
Are you ready to accept the challenge and unlock the mysteries that lie within our campus? Let the treasure hunt begin!

Get in on the action and claim your chance to be recognized as a top-notch detective among your fellow sleuths. Win big and let your investigative prowess dazzle!🔎

Pool Prize: INR 5,500
rules:
• There's only one rule: be the first team to find all the clues and claim victory!
  • Min time Requirement for Event 2 Hour
  • Team size 2-4
  • Join us at [TBA] for an exhilarating introduction to the treasure hunt
  • Our organizers will provide a comprehensive overview of the rules,and the structure of the treasure hunt
  • No of clues to find will get announced

events.name: Artisan Valley
description_paragraphs:
The University of Delhi, the Department of Computer Science, presents Painting/Art competition ARTISAN VALLEY on occasion of 20th annual fest SANKALN’24 Artisan Valley is a celebration of creativity and craftsmanship, providing a platform for artists to showcase their diverse talents. This event aims to bring together a community of artisans, fostering a vibrant atmosphere of appreciation and collaboration. Participants will have the opportunity to exhibit their artworks, connect with fellow creators, and engage with an audience eager to explore the rich tapestry of artistic expression.

Please register on website before filling this form

Form Link ↗

Pool Prize: INR 3,500
rules:
• The competition is open to all college students. Students from all disciplines are encouraged to participate.
  • Participants must adhere to ethical standards and copyright laws in creating their artworks.
  • Any form of plagiarism or infringement will result in disqualification.
  • Respectful behaviour towards fellow participants, judges, and event staff is expected at all times.
  • Submission Guidelines (First Round):
  • Each participant must submit 2 original paintings for the first round of the competition.
  • Paintings can be in any medium such as oil, acrylic, water-color, or mixed media.
  • The theme for the paintings is open, allowing participants to showcase their creativity and style.
  • All entries must be submitted on Google Form by April 18, 2024 08:00 PM. Late submissions will not be accepted.
  • Artworks Selection for Exhibition:
  • Instruction will be reported to selected participants for the Offline submission of paintings.
  • The selected participant’s paintings will be exhibited for public viewing for both the days of SANKALAN.
  • Participants have the option to tag a price for their artwork if they wish to sell it during the exhibition.
  • Competition Round (Second Round):
  • Theme will be declared on the spot. Participants can use their Mobile phones for inspiration but work must be of their own.
  • Participants will have a specified time to create a new artwork based on the given theme.
  • A3/A4-size sheets will be provided by the department for the competition.
  • Participants must bring their own art supplies and materials for the competition round.
  • Result will be announced after lunch.
  • Prizes will be awarded to winners.

events.name: Click-Akrity
description_paragraphs: Greetings from Click Akrity, where the attendees are not only mere spectators but active documentarians! This extraordinary photography event invites aspiring photographers to register and embark on a mission to capture the essence of the entire event. A thrilling blend of originality, ability, and the art of storytelling through the lens, Click Akrity is high stakes because each participant must submit their two best images for the ultimate selection. Don't miss your chance to capture the moment and be part of this spectacular visual extravaganza!

The ultimate photography event where you're not just a viewer but also a storyteller! Armed with your camera, embark on a mission to craft immersive visual tales that showcase the spirit of our gathering. Every participant can submit three photos that best capture the theme - Diversity in Community. It's a thrilling mix of creativity, skill, and storytelling through the lens. Don't miss the chance to seize the moment and be part of this spectacular visual showcase.

Theme - Diversity@DUCS

Pool Prize: INR 3,000
The event will start on April 20th, 2024, 09:00 A.M. onwards. A submission link will be sent to the registered Email ID at the beginning of the event.
Submission Link: https://bit.ly/3xHWl3t
Registration Deadline: April 21, 2024, till 03:00 P.M.
Submission Deadline: April 21, 2024 till 08:00 P.M.
rules:
• Eligibility: College/University Students.
  • The contest is open for online submissions only.
  • Submission date - Apr 19, 2024. No submission will be entertained past the deadline.
  • Only 1 submission is allowed per participant.
  • You are required to provide a creative caption for your photograph.
  • Basic editing including color correction, filters, and cropping are allowed, provided it does not affect the genuineness of the photograph(s).
  • The use of advanced editing to create deceptions, illusions, or manipulate images is strictly prohibited. Any such case will lead to the disqualification of the participant.
  • The participant must follow the official Instagram account of DUCS(@ducsofficial) and Sankalan (@sankalan.ducs).
  • Once the winners are announced, they will be required to share their bank account details through a form for the transfer of prize money. The form link will be sent to the registered email address of the respective winners.

events.name: Desktop Dominion
description_paragraphs: Experience the adrenaline rush of Desktop Dominion, where gamers battle it out on the digital battlefield! Engage in epic clashes, strategic manoeuvres, and thrilling competitions as you showcase your skills in the world of PC gaming. With state-of-the-art setups and exciting challenges, Desktop Dominion is the ultimate destination for gaming aficionados.

Join us for an electrifying celebration of desktop gaming where we delve into the immersive world of digital entertainment! Whether you're a seasoned gamer or just starting your journey, this event promises to captivate and inspire with a plethora of activities and experiences tailored to every gaming enthusiast.
Counter Strike Global Offensive (CSGO) LAN Party

Dive into Heart-Pounding Counter-Strike Action at Our CSGO Gaming Event! Engage in Intense Tactical Battles, Strategize with Your Team, and Aim for Victory in the Ultimate FPS Showdown.

Pool Prize: INR 4,500
rules:
• Solo entry allowed only, we will automatch you with other participants for a team of 5 Players.
  • The first team to win 16 rounds will win.
  • The map will be chosen randomly out of the Pool: Dust2, Nuke, Mirage, vertigo and Inferno.
  • 30 Sec timeout will be given to discuss strategy.
  • Own Gaming Accessories are also allowed like Mouse.
  • Headsets are compulsory ( this will not be given by Event organizers).
  • The competition will have a knockout schedule and rounds will be decided based upon the number of entries.

events.name: Apex Crusade
description_paragraphs:
In the realm of Apex Crusade, your mobile device transforms into a portal of endless possibilities! Dive into captivating adventures, fast-paced challenges, and multiplayer mayhem as you compete for glory in the mobile gaming arena. Whether you're a casual player or a seasoned pro, Apex Crusade offers something for everyone to enjoy!

Form Link: https://forms.gle/4nDtfSgJ26Sf7Xsp8

Pool Prize: INR 8,000
rules:
• Every Particular team's must have 4 Players to participate in the tournament
  • Every player of the team must be registered with their in game name in this form.
  • IGL(in game leader) must have to submit its university ID card.
  • Every team member must have to show their university ID card after Wining the tournament to claim the Prizes and goodies.
  • Any team unable to proof their University identity leads to strict disqualification.
  • Use of any Hacks and other activities like teamup will lead to direct disqualification.

events.name: Electric Elegenza
description_paragraphs: Immerse yourself in an electrifying evening at our DJ night, Electric Elegenza! Surrender to the pulsating beats, dynamic lights, and euphoric atmosphere. Let the rhythm guide your moves and ignite the dance floor with your energy. Lose yourself in a fusion of beats, lights, and vibrant energy. In celebration of another successful Sankalan and to the memories it gave us! So grab your friends, hit the dance floor, and let the music take control! Join us for a night of music, movement, and magic. Let's make it a night to remember!
rules:
• Valid university/college ID card
  • Participation in any of the technical or non-technical events
